Tests that WebSocket related CDP events are emitted.
WebSocketCreated
  url: ws://localhost:8880/echo
  has requestId: true
  has initiator: true
WebSocketWillSendHandshakeRequest
  has wallTime: true
  has request headers: true
WebSocketHandshakeResponseReceived
  status: 101
  has response headers: true
WebSocketFrameSent
  payload: test
  opcode: 1
  mask: true
WebSocketFrameSent
  payload: exit
  opcode: 1
  mask: true
WebSocketFrameReceived
  payload: test
  opcode: 1
  mask: false
WebSocketFrameReceived
  payload: exit
  opcode: 1
  mask: false
WebSocketClosed
  has timestamp: true
